coefficients.provenance: Bytes per attended token (the latent's after the 1x2x2 patchify) plus a base, per geometry and dtype, of one Wan 2.2 transformer forward: the A14B experts, TI2V-5B with one timestep per sample, and TI2V-5B with one per token (image-to-video). AMD Radeon Pro W7900 (gfx1100), torch 2.13.0+rocm10.1.0, Linux, the native allocator, fused SDPA. Measured by scripts/calibrate_wan_working_memory.py on 2026-11-26: bf16, fp16 and fp32 over latent grids from one 1280x720 (A14B) or 1280x704 (TI2V-5B) frame to 121 frames, a 512-token caption, on a random-init transformer of the real geometry with 2 blocks and its float32 modules kept in float32 as the loader keeps them; 4 blocks measured the same at 1280x720x81. demand_peak of the larger of a cold and a warm forward, one fresh process per point. Fitted by scripts/working_memory/build_shipped.py. bf16 and fp16 take the same per token; per-token timesteps about double TI2V-5B's slope. SageAttention's quantized Q/K/V copies, held through every attention call at the largest grid of each geometry, left the demand unchanged (1.000x): the feed-forward sets the peak. Keyed by no platform trait: the term is GEMM and fused attention activations, not convolution workspaces, and the analytic score-matrix term prices a build without a fused kernel. Not measured on CUDA, where the reporter of #9831 ran 1280x720x81 A14B in a 10 GB reservation, below this line's 14.9 GiB: on CUDA the line errs toward fewer resident weights.
